headline: FDA rejects Summit and Akeso's ivonescimab in EGFR mutated lung cancer without an overall survival win
new_fact: On November 15 2026 Summit disclosed an FDA complete response letter for the ivonescimab BLA, citing the lack of a statistically significant overall survival benefit in HARMONi.
